name: speaker_rename
title: Rename a speaker on a recording
description: Relabel one diarized speaker track inside a recording or that recording's episode-of-one, without confirming identity, creating a SpeakerProfile, or enrolling/saving a voiceprint. Use this when the user asks to fix captions such as "Speaker 2 is Adrian" and wants future captioned exports from this recording to use the corrected name. This is rename-only: biometric voice memory and identity confirmation require a human web action in speaker review.

recording_id.description: Recording public ID (`src_...`) or an episode/composition public ID (`comp_...`) that resolves to one recording.

speaker.description: Current speaker display label, speaker_key, or SpeakerMap public ID for the diarized track to rename.

new_name.description: New recording-local display name for this speaker track.

confirm.description: Optional; must be false or omitted. This tool does not confirm identity or save a voiceprint.

speaker_map_summary.description: Updated speaker map summary with display_name, needs_confirmation, confirmed, and appearances_count.
